blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The number of influenza-like illness (ILI) cases in the country increased by 17 percent, according to the latest Ulat ng Ahensya report of the Department of Health. From Oct. 4 to Oct. 17, the DOH recorded 15,122 ILI cases, up from the 12,929 cases reported between Sept. 20 and Oct. 3. Despite the recent increase, the cumulative number of cases remains lower than last year’s figures. From Jan. 4 to Oct. 31, the country recorded 142,246 ILI cases, 18 percent lower than the 173,364 cases reported during the same period in 2025. READ: DOH: Flu-like cases in PH […]...
